title: Kingslayer
lyrics:
[00:25.85]Hi, are you looking for the other side?
[00:29.38]Feel like nothing ever seems quite right?
[00:32.06]Are you circling the drain pipe, getting off on pain like
[00:35.00]You're corrupted?
[00:36.29]I need to know where your loyalties lie
[00:39.80]Tell me are you gonna bark or bite?
[00:42.36]Do you really want to twist the knife
[00:44.43]In the belly of the monster?
[00:46.56]Get the fuck up, wake the fuck up
[00:49.20]Wipe the system and back the fuck up
[00:51.76]You're a puppet when they cut your strings off
[00:54.38]Don't come crawling back
[00:56.32]Kingslayer
[00:58.75]Destroying castles in the sky
[01:01.53]Kingslayer
[01:03.93]Forevermore the apple of my eye
[01:06.93]And I'd sacrifice my life to find you
[01:10.00]Angel of the blade
[01:11.94]Kingslayer
[01:14.16]Come and collect us from the night
[01:28.14]暗い(Cry)
[01:29.05]この見えない世界
[01:31.74]まだ消えない未来
[01:34.30]ただ手に入れたい another world
[01:37.15]System failure
[01:38.53]Life is encrypted, you are modified
[01:41.98]Like a virus in a lullaby
[01:44.63]Artificial till the day you die, silly program
[01:47.61]You're corrupted
[01:48.94]Get the fuck up, wake the fuck up
[01:51.50]Wipe the system and back the fuck up
[01:54.03]You're a puppet when they cut your strings off
[01:56.64]Don't come crawling back, you're on your own
[01:59.81]さあ 時の
[02:02.81]扉を開けて
[02:05.74]行こうよ
[02:09.01]Kingslayer
[02:11.38]Destroying castles in the sky
[02:14.15]Kingslayer
[02:16.63]I'll fight for you until I die
[02:19.40]Kingslayer
[02:21.75]Destroying castles in the sky
[02:24.55]Kingslayer
[02:26.90]Forevermore the apple of my eye
[02:29.91]I'd sacrifice it all to guide you
[02:32.79]Never have to battle alone
[02:34.95]Kingslayer
[02:37.26]Come and collect us from the night
[02:53.07]This is your wake up call
[02:55.65]We're going down the rabbit hole
[02:58.59]Are you ready?
[03:00.31]I can't feel you
[03:23.57]Is this what you want?
[03:26.69]This is what you'll fucking get
[03:30.31]You motherfucking shit
